sourceManifest.scope: Literal direct source runner import closure, including its own bytes; Node identifies built-in modules.

sourceBinding.producer: Private actual-admissible-terminal-covariance.mjs; new pulse jets alias those exact full solution roots.
sourceBinding.sourceMember: The original ellMinimum+8 terminal member, with its positive weight domain; no ell1 pulse is relabeled.

domain.sourceDomain: The selected fixed band; Xplus<X_rep<Xb and Xplus<X<Xb, eta_rep,eta in[-1,1], s_rep,s in[1/2,2], same slow box distance<=4/S^3. Representatives and rounded labels are frozen for slow differentiation.
domain.restriction: Open terminal chart with Xplus<X,Xrep<Xb, 1/2<s,srep<2, |eta|,|etaRep|<1, frozen representative and the same source slow box.
domain.positiveWeights: Consumed from the private actual selected small-q terminal certificate; no caller positivity assumption is substituted.
domain.boundary: At eta=+/-1 use inward finite jets only; no T<0 heat extension. This third-jet certificate is restricted to the open chart. Flat endpoints and cross-label gluing are separate.
domain.norms: Exact parameter-dependent FTC integral envelopes of actual M_alpha and B_alpha and their generated v derivatives. Initial and dummy-time substitutions use fully specified shares whose value and v derivative materialize to the original body. They are locally bounded on compact interior slow neighborhoods; no common all-band C4/Gaussian or numerical bound is inferred.
domain.initial: The original w(0)=(1,0), fixed left0, fixed Ls and frozen carrier/P are actually checked for slow independence.
domain.originalSource: The historical canonical c_n background is used. A separately strengthened a_n background is not silently identified with it.
